item.title: MapleStory Classic World - Zakum Package
item.description:
Title: MapleStory Classic World - Zakum Package
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Free To Play
Developer: NEXON Korea Corporation
Publisher: Nexon America Inc.
Release Date: Oct 6, 2026




About This Content

Become a Founder of Global MapleStory Classic World

Global MapleStory Classic World revisits MapleStory as it was when it first launched, but with gameplay improvements, balance adjustments, and quality of life changes to polish the experience for modern players.

Claim your Zakum Package today and show you were here from the very beginning. This limited-edition bundle brings you Founder's Access on Oct. 6, exclusive Founder's rewards, a striking Manji outfit set, a stealthy Thief outfit set, and several other nostalgic treasures to celebrate your legacy. (All items are purely cosmetic and do not grant any stats or bonuses).

Zakum Package: Tradable within account, 30-day duration. Use to receive:

  • Founder's Access on Oct. 6 : Unlock Founder's Access on Oct. 6, and start playing two weeks before the Grand Launch on Oct. 21!

  • Mark of the Founder (Untradable, Permanent) : Show off your dedication with a stylin’ hat! You’ll receive all three versions of the Mark of the Founder hat. (All items are Untradable and Permanent) :

    • Mark of the Founder (Black)

    • Mark of the Founder (Brown)

    • Mark of the Founder (Tan)

  • Founder’s Effect (Untradable, Permanent) : Toggle a floating icon of a Maple Leaf above your character's head so everyone knows a true founder has arrived! You’ll receive all three versions of the effect. (All items are Untradable and Permanent) :

    • Radiance of the Founder

    • Glow of the Founder

    • Glimmer of the Founder

  • Jr. Balrog Invasion (x50) (Untradable, 90-day duration) : Use this to transform into the fearsome Jr. Balrog for 10 minutes! Intimidate friends and foes alike with this powerful disguise. (This item affects visual appearance only and grants no stat increases) .

  • Well-Loved Outfit Set (Tradable within account, 30-day duration) : A complete outfit set evoking MapleStory’s early years! (All items included in this set are Untradable and Permanent) :

    • Well-Loved Frozen Tuna

    • Well-Loved Brown Bamboo Hat

    • Well-Loved Pan Lid

    • Well-Loved White & Blue Sandals

    • Well-Loved Blue Sauna Robe

    • Well-Loved Work Gloves

  • Founder’s Thief Outfit Set (Tradable within account, 30-day duration) : A complete outfit set designed after the original Thief to help you channel your inner rogue! This set can be equipped by any Job (not only Thief) . (All items included in this set are Untradable and Permanent) :

    • Founder’s Thief Hat

    • Founder’s Thief Outfit

    • Founder’s Thief Boots

    • Founder’s Thief Dagger

    • Founder’s Thief Face

    • Founder’s Thief Gloves

  • Manji’s Outfit Set (Tradable within account, 30-day duration) : A complete outfit set to make you look like the mysterious Manji! (All items included in this set are Untradable and Permanent) :

    • Manji's Bamboo Hat

    • Manji's Clothes

    • Reticent Steps

    • Manji's Blade

    • Silent Sea of Clouds

  • Founder’s Ring Coupon (Tradable within account, 30-day duration) : Contains two equippable rings, both Untradable and Permanent:

    • Founder's Chat Ring : Equip this ring to display your chat messages inside a wooden sign bubble when you chat on a map.

    • Founder's Label Ring : Equip this ring and your character name will appear on a weathered sign below your character avatar.

Disclaimer:

  • All package items are delivered automatically upon your first login to Classic World, with no manual coupon redemption needed. You can claim these items from your in-game mailbox until November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC .

  • You will need to leave Maple Island before you can open your Zakum Package items, and once you claim it from your mailbox, you will have 30 days to open it.

  • The Zakum Package can be purchased once per account on each platform (once on the Nexon website and once on Steam). Please note that a single purchase will grant all items and Founder's access.

  • Content is only available in MapleStory Classic World .

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do the items in the Zakum Package grant any stat bonuses?

A: No, all items included in the Zakum Package are purely cosmetic. They do not grant any stats, bonuses, or enhance your character's gameplay in any way.

Q: Can any character equip the outfit set item?

A: Yes, all items in the outfit sets--Well Loved Outfit Set, Founder's Thief Outfit Set, and Manji's Outfit Set--can be equipped by any character regardless of gender or job. There are also no weapon restrictions.

Q: How do I receive my Zakum Package items?

A: All package items are delivered automatically upon your first login to Classic World, with no manual coupon redemption needed. You can claim these items from your in-game mailbox until November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC . Note that the Zakum Package can only be claimed once per account, and you will need to leave Maple Island before you can open your Zakum Package items. After picking up your package, you will have 30 days to open your package.

Q: When can I start playing?

A: The Zakum Package includes Founder's Access. You can start playing on October 6, 2026. Details regarding the server launch time will be provided at a later date.

Q: Can I play in Founder's Access with any Nexon account?

A: No, Founder's Access is linked to the account that purchased the Zakum Package.

Q: Which platforms and devices are supported?

A: Global MapleStory Classic World will be available to play on both Windows and macOS.

Q: Will my Founder's Access progress carry over to the Grand Launch?

A: Yes, all in-game progress made during Founder's Access (starting October 6, 2026 ) will be carried over as the game officially launches on October 21, 2026.

Q: Can I use the Zakum Package items outside of MapleStory Classic World?

A: No, the contents of the package are only available in MapleStory Classic World.

Q: Do the Zakum Package items expire?

A: Yes, you must pick up the items from your in-game mailbox on Classic World before November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC . If not claimed from your mailbox, the items will expire. Please see above for the details on duration and tradability.
Note: Outfit sets come packaged in a box that have a 30-day duration and are tradable within your account. Upon opening the box, the resulting outfit items are permanent and untradable but can be transferred to other characters on the same account and within the same world via the Cash Inventory.

Q: Is there a deadline to purchase the Zakum Package?

A: Yes, the Zakum Package is only available for a limited time! Once the sale window closes at 11:59 PM PDT on October 14, 2026 , the package will no longer be available for purchase.

Q: Where can I purchase other packages? Are other packages available?

A: Snail and Orange Mushroom Packages are available on our official Nexon website.

Q: Is the Zakum Package the same on the Nexon website and Steam?

A: Yes, the Zakum Package is the same on the Nexon website and Steam. Both packages have the same items and Founder's Access. You can purchase the Zakum Package on your preferred platform.

Q: Who do I contact if I have an issue with my purchase or missing items?

A: If you have any questions about your purchase, please contact Player Support on the official Nexon website.

**Please refer to the Founder’s Package details on the official Nexon website for more detailed information**

System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Ashes and Ascension
item.description:
Title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Ashes and Ascension
Genre: Action
Developer: Piranha Games Inc.
Publisher: Piranha Games Inc.
Franchise: MechWarrior
Release Date: Oct 6, 2026




About This Content

Lead your Mercenary Company through a New Campaign.

Looking to capitalize on the rare show of cooperation between the Great Houses following the Battle of Coventry, First Prince Victor Steiner-Davion has called on all the nations of the Inner Sphere to come together to respond to the threat of a renewed Clan invasion. Lyran Alliance Archon Katrina Steiner-Davion graciously offers to host the international conference on Tharkad.

With the fate of the entire Inner Sphere at stake, all eyes now turn to the First Whitting Conference. And everyone, be they house loyalist or independent mercenary, cannot help but be sucked up into the conference’s all-consuming orbit.

  • Experience an 18-mission campaign, our longest yet.

  • Hunt down 10 new High-Reward Crates.

  • Explore the updated Inner Sphere map, spanning 3058–3060.

  • Jump into Career Mode with 5 new faction starts set in 3050.

Expand your arsenal

  • Acquire 13 new 'Mechs - Arctic Cheetah, Arctic Wolf, Ice Ferret, Huntsman, Hunchback IIC, Nova Cat, Sun Spider, Marauder IIC, Warhammer IIC, Blood Asp, Supernova, Stone Rhino, and Bane.

  • Deploy 3 new Inner Sphere OmniMechs, the Blackjack, Black Hawk-KU, and Perseus.

  • Discover 9 new Inner Sphere 'Mech variants, including the Annihilator, Hatamoto-Chi, King Crab, Longbow, Nightstar, Phoenix Hawk, Victor, Centurion, and Hunchback.

  • Equip your 'Mechs with 11 new Inner Sphere weapons, including IS ER Small and Medium Lasers, IS Ultra Autocannons, IS LB-X Autocannons, the IS Light Gauss Rifle, and IS Streak SRMs.

  • Face new ground unit variants and threats, including the Po, Ontos, Hetzer, Demolisher II, Patton, and Condor.

    • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770/AMD Radeon R9 280X
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 80 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection is needed to play and host Co-op games. Internet Connection is NOT Required for Single player once the game is downloaded.

    • Memory: 16 GB RAM

    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 80 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection is needed to play and host Co-op games. Internet Connection is NOT Required for Single player once the game is downloaded.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day
item.description:
Title: Gears of War: E-Day
Genre: Action , Adventure
Developer: The Coalition
Publisher: Xbox Game Studios
Franchise: Gears of War
Release Date: Oct 6, 2026




About This Game

Emergence Begins

Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP.* Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet.

The Story of E-Day

Fight through the chaos of Emergence Day in a gripping origin story campaign.

Battle alone or rally up to four players online across Campaign, Horde Siege, and Versus.*

Horde Siege PvE – Back and Bigger Than Ever

Survive a city under siege in an evolved take on Gears’ iconic co-op wave survival mode built for larger maps, more players, and bigger battles.

Choose your class - Assault, Marksman, Medic, or Breacher - then drop in as a 4-player squad to fight back the Locust.

Team up with multiple squads to conquer shared objectives and take down world bosses. Survive to earn rewards, unlock customization and improve your loadout for the next match.

Versus Returns – Refined and Focused PvP

Battle across all-new maps and refined fan-favorite 4v4 modes.

Choose your level of competition. Lock in and climb the ranks in Ranked or jump into Social playlists for a more relaxed match.

Modernized controls and movement make combat feel more fluid while retaining Gears’ signature cover-based feel. Jump, vault, slide, and flank with intent.

A Terrifying Threat from Below

A darker, grittier tone and reimagined enemies restore fear and dread to the series.

Atmosphere and detail are pushed further than ever. The world feels more grounded, believable, and dangerous.

Familiar enemies are more threatening, joined by all-new creatures and villains that reestablish a true sense of horror.

Feels Like Gears. Plays Like New.

Iconic cover‑based combat returns, enhanced with modernized movement and traversal that add freedom and verticality.

Fan‑favorite weapons return and are reimagined, alongside all‑new weapons built for brutal, close‑quarters combat.

Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5

A new technical foundation for Gears. Built for modern performance with 4K resolution and up to 60FPS across Campaign and Multiplayer.*

Optimized to Customize

Enjoy a great experience on any setup with smooth performance across a wide range of hardware, with borderless/exclusive/windowed display modes, uncapped frame rates on capable hardware, ultrawide support (21:9 and 32:9) for gameplay and menus, and KBM/controller remapping.*

Advanced Performance & Graphics*

Play in crisp 4K Ultra HD with HDR10 and hardware ray-traced lighting, reflections, and shadows.

Push performance further with PC features including NVIDIA DLSS 4.5, AMD FSR “Redstone,” optional Frame Generation and Multi Frame Generation on supported hardware, Variable Rate Shading, and a built-in benchmark mode.

Handheld-Ready & Cross-Platform Play

Fully optimized for handheld play on Steam Deck, Xbox Ally X, and Xbox Ally devices.

Optional account linking lets you carry progress with roaming saves, connect with friends, and send cross-platform invites – then squad up in 2-4 player online co-op or jump into competitive multiplayer for up to 8 players across supported platforms.

*Important Information

4K, Ultrawide, HDR, Uncapped, 60FPS & Advanced Graphics: requires compatible, capable hardware and display.

Game requires initial download. May require future updates (additional storage may be required). All downloads and updates require significant storage and broadband internet connection (ISP fees apply). You must accept the Microsoft Services Agreement. May require additional hardware and subscriptions. Content, features, services, online play (if applicable), and support not available in all regions and may vary, change, or terminate. Microsoft Account required.

WARNING: Some people may experience a seizure when exposed to flashing lights or patterns in video games.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit 22H 19045.7291
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel i7‑6850K / i5‑10400
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Hardware Ray Tracing capable GPU is required. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 / Radeon RX 9060
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 115 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
    • Additional Notes: Storage: SSD required (solid-state drive)
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 64bit (25H2) or newer
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel i5-11600K
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT / Radeon RX 9060 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 115 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
    • Additional Notes: Storage: SSD required (solid-state drive)

Title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
Genre: Action , Adventure , Racing , Simulation , Sports
Developer: Fuse Games
Publisher: Secret Mode
Franchise: Star Wars
Release Date: Oct 6, 2026




About This Game

​​​​​Star Wars ​​: Galactic Racer™ is a ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​ Star Wars​​ ™​​ galaxy.​​​​

The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground.

Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive.

No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise.

Slam, shunt, and takedown rivals across varied circuits as you pilot landspeeders, speeder bikes, skim speeders, and podracers. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

Join the Galactic League - an unsanctioned racing circuit born in the lawless Outer Rim. Become Shade, a lone racer chasing revenge and glory.

Pilot different classes of repulsorcraft each with distinct physics and playstyles. Build a ride that showcases your style and gives you a competitive edge.

Ride solo through a story-driven campaign of shifting alliances or brave strategic PvP grudge matches where reputation rides with you.

Prove yourself through intense rivalries and escalating challenges. Every choice shapes your prospects as you build your status in the Galactic League .

item.title: AION 2
item.description:
Title: AION 2
Genre: Action , Adventure , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Free To Play
Developer: NC
Publisher: NC
Release Date: Oct 5, 2026




About This Game

The sky is not the limit. It is the battlefield.

Built on Unreal Engine 5 across a world 36 times larger than the original AION, this is the only MMORPG built for aerial combat. Verticality is in the DNA of AION 2, and rewards players who can think, and fight, in 3 dimensions.

Every region, every battlefield, every encounter was designed with verticality as its axis. As a Daeva, flight is not a travel mechanic, it is how you fight, how you explore, and how you impose your will on the world. Gain altitude to gain advantage, and experience a scale of aerial combat unlike any other MMORPG.

Precision, timing, and positioning shape every battle. Chain skills seamlessly, customize your class to fit your playstyle, and adapt as encounters escalate. Every fight is a decision, not a rotation.

From solo instances to large-scale raids, AION 2 PvE is built around scale and variety. Over 200 dungeons span multiple formats: solo challenges, 5-player party content, and 10-player group dungeons. Seasonal challenges, competitive rankings, and open-world events keep the excitement high, and the Abyss ensures that PvE and faction war are never far apart.

Bring your vision to life with one of the most advanced character creation systems in an MMORPG. With over 200 customization options and countless outfits, mounts, and wings to collect, your character becomes a true expression of who you are.

The Shugo Festival brings a variety of mini-games to Atreia. Protect the Shugos from waves of enemies, race pets against other players, dodge lasers, and more. Earn unique rewards including wings, skins, pets, and décor!

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some in-game assets were created with the assistance of AI tools.
Arcana card designs and some icons use AI-generated assets.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2600 / Intel® Core™ i5-10500
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended. When using FHD resolution in-game, set the graphics preset to Very Low to ensure compatibility.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 3700X / Intel® Core™ i7-11700
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 (8GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended. When using FHD resolution in-game, set the graphics preset to Low to ensure compatibility.
